title: Continuity of local mass along increasing unions of open sets
statement:
Let P, k ∈ ℕ, let U ⊆ ℝ^P be an arbitrary set, and let T ∈ D_k(U) = GeometricCurrentOn U k. Let O_0 ⊆ O_1 ⊆ O_2 ⊆ ⋯ be open subsets of ℝ^P. Then M_{⋃_i O_i}(T) = sup_i M_{O_i}(T) in [0, ∞].
Here M_V(T) = T.massOn V is the supremum of ENNReal.ofReal(T(ω)) over the test forms ω ∈ D^k(U) with tsupport ω ⊆ V and |ω(x)| ≤ 1 for all x, where |·| = covectorEuclideanNorm.
lean_statement: ∀ (P k : ℕ) (U : Set (Eucl P)) (T : GeometricCurrentOn U k) (O : ℕ → Set (Eucl P)), (∀ i, IsOpen (O i)) → Monotone O → T.massOn (⋃ i, O i) = ⨆ i, T.massOn (O i)
